{{Quote|Do you think he'd teach me to be a bounty hunter, too?''"''<br />''"''I don't think the ''Skups'' were ever known to do much in the way of bounty hunting.|The Skup Anky Fremp and the Rodian Greedo|<ref name="AHF" />}}
The '''Skups''', or '''Sionian Skups''', were a [[near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who differed from standard [[Human/Legends|Humans]] due to their small, closely spaced [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], delicate [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and skin the [[Color/Legends|color]] of [[dianoga cheese]].

Legend held that in [[Pre-Republic era|ancient times]], another species [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetically altered]] the Skups to sell them to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], who dominated the region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] around the Skup [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Sionia]].<ref name="EA" /> The species exhibited a wide range of [[Gene/Legends|genetic]] features, and at least some Skups were referred to as biomorphs. The Skups were not known for their prowess as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], although their [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] were renowned. [[Anky Fremp]], a denizen of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and a friend of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] street urchin [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], was a Sionian Skup.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Skup_fingers.png|thumb|left|The Skup Anky Fremp had long fingers.]]
The Skups, also known as the Sionian Skups, were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[near-Human]]s<ref name="CSWE I 295">{{CSWECite|I|295|Fremp, Anky}}</ref> who resembled mainline [[Human/Legends|Humans]] in many respects.<ref name="CSWE III 153" /> Members of the species had two [[Limb/Legends|arms]], two legs, a torso, and a head, giving them a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] frame. The face featured a [[Nose/Legends|nose]], a [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] with [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] and a [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]] inside, and [[Ear/Legends|ears]] on each side of the head.<ref name="AHFw">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/webstrips/greedo/index.html?show=1|text=A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale|int=A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale (webstrip)}}</ref> Skups were capable of swallowing.<ref name="AHF" /> Certain features distinguished them from Humans, however: They had beady, close-set [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], brittle [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and skin that matched the [[Color/Legends|color]] of [[dianoga cheese]].<ref name="CSWE III 153" /> The Skups had at least one [[Gender/Legends|sex]], male.<ref name="AHF" />

The Skup species showed a huge array of [[Gene/Legends|genetic]] traits,<ref name="EA" /> and at least some members of the species were called biomorphs. For instance, one Skup biomorph<ref name="CSWE I 295" /> had legs that were disproportionately short for his frame,<ref name="AHF" /> while his arms were long. He had four attenuated fingers per hand. His pointed nose protruded like a beak, and his teeth were small and peg-like. His hair grew long and straight from his scalp like the bristles of a brush.<ref name="AHFw" />

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|Wow. Will ya share it with ''me''?''"''<br />''"''Yeah &hellip; I'll throw a few credits your way, Fremp. But most of it I'm going to use to buy me my own ''ship''. Ninx has got a cute little Incom corsair he'll let me have for fourteen thousand. All she needs is new power couplings.''"''<br />''"''That's nothing. We can ''steal'' the couplings!|Anky Fremp and Greedo discuss the prize from Greedo's first bounty|<ref name="AHF" />}}
The Skups were [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], the species that dominated the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] where the Skup [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was located.<ref name="EA" /> The Skups were renowned for their deft [[Thief/Legends|thieves]], some of whom became masters of the act of pilferage. In contrast, they were not known for their [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].<ref name="AHF" /> At least some members of the species [[Clothing/Legends|dressed]] to the standards of other humanoid species, wearing such items as [[Hat/Legends|hats]], [[shirt]]s, jackets, [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], trousers, and shoes. Skups were capable of speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]. At least one Skup had a two-part name: [[Anky Fremp]].<ref name="AHFw" />

==History==
The Skups hailed from [[Sionia]],<ref name="CSWE III 153" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. According to legend, a species with advanced [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetic engineering]] technology tampered with the Skups and sold the entire species to the Hutts as slaves at some forgotten [[Time/Legends|time]] in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] past.<ref name="EA" />

==Skups in the galaxy==
[[File:Skup_in_the_city.png|thumb|right|upright|The Skup Anky Fremp lived on Nar Shaddaa.]]
The Skup Anky Fremp lived on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], where he worked for various criminal gangs.<ref name="CSWE I 295" /> Circa [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], Fremp befriended the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] drifter [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], whom the Skup taught the skills of living on the street, such as how to steal items and fence them. The two worked as a team for two years.<ref name="AHF" />

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Greedo struck a deal with two [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters, [[Dyyz Nataz]] and [[Spurch Goa|Spurch "Warhog" Goa]]: In exchange for helping them capture some members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], who were running [[Blaster/Legends|guns]] on Nar Shaddaa's [[Level 88]], Goa would teach Greedo the ins and outs of bounty hunting. Despite Fremp's requests to join the scheme, Greedo intended to use the association to move away from the small time and break association with the Skup. Greedo also intended to purchase his own [[Starship/Legends|starship]], an [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] [[Corsair/Legends|corsair]] known as the ''[[Manka Hunter]]''. At a [[Spacebarn|shop]] on Nar Shaddaa, Greedo and Fremp were caught attempting to steal [[Dekk-6 power coupling]]s for the vessel from the Human [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], prompting Fremp to run away.<ref name="AHF" /> The Skup was still living on Nar Shaddaa<ref name="DE3">[[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]]</ref> in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].<ref name="SWCC">''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Anky_and_Greedo.png|thumb|left|The canon status of the association of the Skup Anky Fremp and the Rodian Greedo was rendered ambiguous by ''The Clone Wars'' television show.]]
A large-nosed humanoid drawn by artist [[Cam Kennedy]] appears in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]] as a background character. The comic was first published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in [[April]] [[1992]].<ref name="DE3" /> The character went unnamed until [[Tom Veitch]]'s short story, "[[A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale]]," was published by [[Bantam Spectra]] in [[1995]] as part of ''[[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]''. The story alternates between referring to Fremp's species as "Siona Skups" and "Sionian Skups."<ref name="AHF" /> In a [[A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale (webstrip)|webstrip]] based on Veitch's story, illustrated by [[Pablo Hidalgo]], the large-nosed character from ''Dark Empire 3'' was linked to the character Anky Fremp from the short story.<ref name="AHFw" />

Other sources that have provided information on the species include the ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', written by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] and published in [[1998]],<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]].<ref name="CSWE III 153" /><ref name="CSWE I 295" /> These sources have disagreed over the name of the Skups' homeworld; ''Star Wars Encyclopedia'' calls it Sionan,<ref name="SWE" /> while ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' calls it Sionia.<ref name="CSWE III 153" /> In 2009, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], established the planet name as Sionia and provided additional information about the species and its association with the Hutts.<ref name="EA" />

That much of the information about the Skup species comes from Fremp's appearance in "A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale" and its webcomic adaptation presents [[Canon|continuity]] issues. While that story purports to tell the background of the Rodian bounty hunter Greedo, a different character history was presented by ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] in a deleted scene from [[1999]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and in [[2010]]'s "[[Sphere of Influence]]," an episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated television series. "Sphere of Influence" makes Greedo's street education in the years leading up to [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] improbable given that Greedo is shown as a luckless bounty hunter many years earlier during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. No source clarified Greedo's association with Anky Fremp&mdash;and, thus, the details about Fremp's own life on the moon.<ref name="SoI blog">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode304.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Sphere of Influence}}</ref>
